program.notes: Open-fronted trading hall with stalls facing the market square; the heart of the town.
Warm hearth, lantern-lit common room, rooms upstairs, sign over the door.
Forge, anvil and open work yard; stands slightly off the square.
Brick oven, bread display in the window, hay sacks and barrels.
Small stalls for produce, cloth and tools around the square.
Small homes with gardens and flower boxes along the lanes.
